  description: 'MECHANISM PROFILE (seed: drm/amd/pm vega10 fan RPM div-by-zero). Untrusted source: a numeric (u32) value supplied by a local unprivileged user through a kernel control interface (sysfs/hwmon fan RPM store -> power-management helper). Missing guarantee: input validation screens the literal raw value (==0, min/max fan RPM) but no bound ties the input to the representable range of the expression derived from it; i.e. the invariant ''every value used as a divisor must be proven nonzero at the exact integer width where the division executes'' is absent. Unsafe use: a constant scaling (8 * speed) is applied in fixed-width 32-bit arithmetic, wraps modulo 2^32 to 0 when speed > UINT_MAX/8, and the wrapped product is then used as the denominator of a division (tach period), so a nonzero user input becomes a zero divisor; representation-equivalents include subtraction/addition under/overflow to 0, right-shift truncation to 0, and narrowing casts of nonzero wider values. Consequence: integer division by zero -> kernel oops/DoS and stalled PM programming (reliability bug, not memory corruption). Transferable pattern: denominator = f(untrusted_value) where f applies unchecked fixed-width scaling before ''/'' or ''%'', while all checks validate f''s input instead of f''s output at division width. BRANCHES: branch1=hwmon-sysfs-scaled-divisor: sysfs/hwmon/thermal store handlers (fan RPM/pwm/target/limit attributes) where user input is multiplied, shifted, added, or subtracted in fixed width and then used as divisor in division/modulo during device programming - hunt for wrapped-zero or truncated-zero denominators; branch2=drm-userif-divisor: DRM/graphics driver user interfaces (sysfs, debugfs, ioctls for fan, clocks, power/OD settings across vendors/ASICs) where user-supplied numeric params are transformed into tach/divider/ratio values with unchecked arithmetic before a division; branch3=chardev-ioctl-divisor: non-DRM character-device ioctls (iio, media/DVB, HID, input, misc) accepting user numeric parameters (rates, periods, gains, timeouts, counts) that become divisors after unchecked fixed-width scaling or subtraction, including modulo-by-wrapped-zero; branch4=firmware-table-divisor: driver parsing of device/firmware-provided data (VBIOS/powerplay tables, ACPI, SMBIOS, EDID, DT properties, EEPROM) whose fields are used directly as divisors or scaled operands without range validation, reproducing the same zero/overflow-denominator from a non-user untrusted source.'

  "one_line_summary": "drm/amd/pm: Prevent division by zero",
  "vulnerability_summary": "User-controlled fan speed value passed to vega10_fan_ctrl_set_fan_speed_rpm lacks upper-bound validation. When speed exceeds UINT_MAX/8, the expression 8*speed wraps to zero, causing division by zero in tach_period calculation.",
  "vulnerability_pattern": "User-supplied divisor multiplied by a constant before division without overflow check, allowing wraparound to zero and divide-by-zero.",
  "patch": "commit 4b8c3c0d17c07f301011e2908fecd2ebdcfe3d1c
Author: Denis Arefev <arefev@swemel.ru>
Date:   Fri Mar 21 14:08:15 2025 +0300

    drm/amd/pm: Prevent division by zero
    
    The user can set any speed value.
    If speed is greater than UINT_MAX/8, division by zero is possible.
    
    Found by Linux Verification Center (linuxtesting.org) with SVACE.
    
    Fixes: c52dcf49195d ("drm/amd/pp: Avoid divide-by-zero in fan_ctrl_set_fan_speed_rpm")
    Signed-off-by: Denis Arefev <arefev@swemel.ru>
    Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
    Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/powerplay/hwmgr/vega10_thermal.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/powerplay/hwmgr/vega10_thermal.c
index 379012494da5..56423aedf3fa 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/powerplay/hwmgr/vega10_thermal.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/powerplay/hwmgr/vega10_thermal.c
@@ -307,10 +307,10 @@ int vega10_fan_ctrl_set_fan_speed_rpm(struct pp_hwmgr *hwmgr, uint32_t speed)
 	int result = 0;
 
 	if (hwmgr->thermal_controller.fanInfo.bNoFan ||
-	    speed == 0 ||
+	    (!speed || speed > UINT_MAX/8) ||
 	    (speed < hwmgr->thermal_controller.fanInfo.ulMinRPM) ||
 	    (speed > hwmgr->thermal_controller.fanInfo.ulMaxRPM))
-		return -1;
+		return -EINVAL;
 
 	if (PP_CAP(PHM_PlatformCaps_MicrocodeFanControl))
 		result = vega10_fan_ctrl_stop_smc_fan_control(hwmgr);
"
}
